title: 建立 Core 身份与公开资料最小纵向链路
objective: 完成 Core 预发布契约、Keycloak 本地开发环境、幂等 IdentityLink、最小 Profile 与 GET /v1/me 的真实可运行身份纵向链路。
in_scope: 在 Contracts 锁定首个可实现的 Core 预发布契约及兼容分类，GET /v1/me 只返回公共 Actor
在 Ops 建立使用独立 PostgreSQL 数据库与用户、本地邮件接收和占位秘密的非生产 Keycloak/Core 开发组合
在 Core 验证 token signature、issuer、audience、expiry 与 email_verified 后，以 (issuer, subject) 唯一映射稳定 MC Plan 用户 ID
在单一 Core PostgreSQL 事务中幂等创建 IdentityLink、最小 Profile 与必要审计记录，不发布未经 Contracts 定义的跨服务事件
为首次并发登录、业务账号状态、重复登录、公开响应字段和契约一致性提供自动化测试
使用真实 Keycloak 开发环境完成受控测试客户端认证到 GET /v1/me 的集成验收，同时保留本地签名 issuer 快速测试
out_of_scope: Developer App、PAT、业务角色、管理员接口、每日权益、积分账本、奖励、退款或计费
Community、Skin 或 Official Skin 登录集成以及 SDK/消费者实现
生产域名、生产邮件、腾讯云正式环境、真实密钥、远程仓库、推送或部署
按邮箱合并、身份重绑、账号恢复、第二身份、正式 IdP 迁移或跨服务事件发布
contract_impact: compatible prerelease lock: promote the existing draft GET /v1/me and PublicActor surface to the first implementable Core prerelease, add explicit authentication, insufficient-scope and business-account rejection responses, and preserve the public actor field boundary
acceptance_evidence: Contracts Python and Redocly validation pass with unique operationId, resolved references, explicit scope/error responses and recorded compatibility classification
Core format, lint, typecheck, unit, integration, end-to-end, architecture, migration, contract and build validations pass
Concurrent first login converges to one McPlanUser, one IdentityLink and one Profile without orphan users
GET /v1/me returns only the public Actor contract and rejects invalid tokens, unverified email and disallowed Core account status
A real local Keycloak token reaches Core GET /v1/me through the Ops development combination with isolated databases, valid probes and no real secrets
The Core runtime image builds and its liveness/readiness endpoints pass after explicit migration
validation_results: Coordination Start passed with Core as primary, Contracts and Ops as the only supporting repositories, and the independent Skin-only lock unchanged

Contracts 0.1.0-alpha.1 locked GET /v1/me, profile:read, PublicActor, AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE and ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE as a prerelease compatible convergence from the unpublished draft

Isolated Python validation passed for 13 JSON schemas/events, 13 unique ids, 3 OpenAPI documents and 15 unique operationIds, including machine checks for scopes, error examples, PublicActor privacy and compatibility classification
Redocly recommended lint passed for all Core, Community and Skin OpenAPI documents
Contracts initial checkpoint af58437f2f58a7c3876c9327d98df82fe9689c96 and final forbidden-scope refinement f9ad077de7e031c2679909b8ad27dcf4e9b2340e were committed before producer implementation
Core format, lint, strict typecheck, build, architecture and two forward-only migration validations passed
Core unit suite passed 21/21 and HTTP end-to-end suite passed 7/7, covering local-signature token rejection, profile:read, PublicActor-only responses and stable Problem Details

Core isolated PostgreSQL integration suite passed 2/2; twelve concurrent first-logins converged to one user, one IdentityLink, one Profile, one audit and one internal unpublished outbox record, with repeat-login idempotency and suspended-account rejection
Core contract verification passed for 5 locked files at Contracts 0.1.0-alpha.1 and the producer response passed the locked PublicActor JSON Schema
Core runtime image mc-plan-core:mcp-f1-core-002 built successfully as a non-root Node 24 image

Ops checkpoint 666565b477863c90974222e90444be2e7028c12a pins Keycloak 26.8.0, PostgreSQL 17.10 and Mailpit 1.31.3 in a loopback-only non-production composition with independent Core and Keycloak databases/users and local-only placeholder credentials

Fresh-volume runtime acceptance passed: Authorization Code plus PKCE S256 issued an RS256 token whose signature, issuer, audience, expiry, verified-email and subject claims were accepted by Core; twelve concurrent GET /v1/me responses converged to user c991f7fa-6052-49f3-9c6c-e83b4077cabc

The real runtime acceptance applied both forward migrations, passed Core liveness/readiness, verified exact PublicActor fields and a generated Explorer nickname, and found exactly one user, IdentityLink, Profile, audit record and unpublished internal outbox record

Final Contracts validation passed for 13 schemas/events, 13 unique ids, 3 OpenAPI documents and 15 unique operationIds; Redocly recommended lint passed all three APIs; compatibility evidence was committed as 070b00ae27bda4c3ec2d5cdd08cece626c8878a7

Final Core format, lint, typecheck, 21 unit tests, 2 isolated PostgreSQL integration tests, 7 HTTP end-to-end tests, architecture, 2 forward-only migrations, locked-contract test and build all passed; the non-root runtime image starts as node and reports live plus ready with current migrations

Final Ops static validation passed pinned-image, compose parsing, independent database identity, realm/client mapper, loopback, local SMTP, PKCE S256 and no-real-secret gates; final acceptance assertions were committed as ff0eeb7ff61301af762ba05ab58459b6c707577e
Coordination Continue passed after all three repository checkpoints and final acceptance evidence were recorded; the independent Skin-only workstream remained untouched
